### Family: protect your child's Mac
- Pair a child's Mac with your Kahf ID using a pairing code. The child's settings come from you, and the child can't change them on their own. - **Parent mode:** at the child's Mac, enter your lock PIN to unlock its settings for 15 minutes. Changes are saved to your account and show on your phone too. - The child can still open every card to see what's on; changing anything asks for the lock PIN. - Uninstall protection follows your choice, and you can switch it from the child's Mac in parent mode.
### Organisations
- When your organisation turns off uninstall protection, you can disable it right away, with no 24-hour wait. - A Mac managed by an organisation no longer has Sign Out. When the organisation removes it, it resets itself to a fresh install.
### Mindful Pause
- No more introduction screens: it opens straight to your apps, with a short "How it works" card the first time.
